activity_summary: Home at Great St Helen's after Richard's birthday supper at the Jackdaw, you set down the full vote of all eight men in the tiring-house, Kemp's lone dissent, Pope making you own that August is for the pages, and the jaw that sent you home at nine.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the late-night note at Great St Helen's after returning from the Jackdaw.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Carried the vote and entered the three dates with no sum under them.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Stood alone against resting the house in August.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Forced William to admit August suits him better than hired men.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Put a constable and my lord's warrant on every mile of the road.

entities.name: James Burbage
entities.context: Took the twenty-sixth to keep his house earning.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Asked for three clear weeks in August to con the King and received the pearwood glass.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Sat his chest silent at the vote and sang at the Jackdaw.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Mentioned in Summer reckoning and vote — 7 July

entities.name: the pearwood glass
entities.context: Mentioned in Summer reckoning and vote — 7 July

facets.activity: Wrote down the summer closure vote and August pages
